name: MixedVisibilityFiles
author: Daniel Scherzer
@note: Only list specific tested MediaWiki versions given how unstable the extension is

MixedVisibilityFilesPrefixRestrictions.description: Map of file name prefixes to user group(s). Files whose name starts with a given prefix are restricted to users in the specified group(s). Each key is a prefix string and each value is either a group name (string) or an array of group names. Prefix matching is case-sensitive; note that MediaWiki normalizes the first character of file names to uppercase. Example: {"Confidential_": "sysop", "Internal_": ["sysop", "bureaucrat"]}
